name: agent-tree-monitor-cursor
description: Open a live ASCII agent tree monitor in a Cursor side panel.

agentTreeMonitor.transcriptRoot.description: Optional override for the Cursor agent-transcripts directory.

agentTreeMonitor.refreshSeconds.description: Refresh interval for the monitor webview.

agentTreeMonitor.modelContextLimits.description: Optional model-specific context token limits keyed by exact recorded model name, for example {"composer-2-fast": 200000}.

agentTreeMonitor.modelTelemetryPath.description: Optional override for Cursor hook model telemetry JSONL. Defaults to ~/.cursor/agent-tree-monitor/model-events.jsonl.
